title_en: Fully Equipped Fried Chicken Franchise – Business Asset Sale
title_ko: 치킨 프랜차이즈 – 비즈니스 자산 매매 (주방 설비 완비)
desc_ko: 캘거리 유동 인구가 많은 지역의 치킨 프랜차이즈(Chicko Chicken) 자산 매매입니다. 신형 고급 주방 설비, 12피트 후드, 화장실 2개(장애인용 1개), 넉넉한 주차 공간을 갖추고 있습니다. 프랜차이즈를 그대로 운영하거나, 건물주 승인 시 새로운 콘셉트로 바꿀 수 있습니다. 월 임대료 $7,401.13 (기본 임대료, 관리비, GST, 가스, 수도 포함, 전기 별도), 2034년 2월까지 10년 리스.
desc_en: Business Asset Sale – Fully Equipped Fried Chicken Franchise Opportunity in Calgary. You can continue operating as Chicko Chicken or change to your own business concept. Seize this rare chance to own a well-established Canadian franchise specializing in crispy fried chicken, located in a high-traffic area of Calgary. Renowned for its high-quality chicken and a variety of unique, flavorful sauces, this brand has built a strong and loyal customer base. The premises come fully equipped with brand-new, high-end commercial kitchen equipment, ensuring efficient and reliable operations. Features include two well-maintained washrooms (one wheelchair accessible), a spacious 12-foot commercial canopy for heavy-duty ventilation, and a large designated storage area to support high-volume service. Ample customer parking adds to the convenience and accessibility of this prime location. This turn-key operation is ready for immediate takeover. The new owner can continue under the successful franchise model or introduce a new food concept, subject to landlord approval—offering flexibility to align with your business vision. Ideal for both experienced operators and newcomers, this opportunity provides a solid foundation for long-term success in a proven market. The total monthly rent is $7,401.13, which includes basic rent, operating costs, GST, gas, and water. Electricity is extra. This is a 10-year lease expiring in February 2034.

title_ko: 구두 수선 & 옷 수선 비즈니스 (2009년부터 운영)
desc_ko: 17 Avenue SW 번화가에서 2009년부터 운영 중인 구두 수선 및 옷 수선 비즈니스입니다. 단골과 워크인 고객이 꾸준하며, 시내에 경쟁 업체가 거의 없습니다. 662 sq.ft., 직원 없이 1인 운영이 가능하고 운영 비용이 낮습니다. 장비, 인테리어, 상호, 전화번호, 고객 명단이 포함되며 재고는 원가로 별도 계산합니다. 현 소유주가 교육을 제공합니다. 건물주의 리스 양도 승인이 필요합니다.
desc_en: This is a rare chance to buy a well-established shoe care and alterations business. It is located in a busy retail area on 17 Avenue SW in Calgary. The shop has operated here since 2009. It has a steady base of walk-in and repeat customers. There is very little competition left in the city for this skilled trade. The space is about 662 square feet on the main floor. The building is well-managed with great street exposure. It gets strong foot traffic and has easy parking nearby. The sale includes all shop equipment, leasehold improvements, the business name, phone number, and client list. Inventory is sold separately at cost upon closing. This is a simple business with low overhead. It has no employees and needs little inventory. It is perfect for an owner-operator. The current owner will provide full training for a smooth takeover. There is great potential to grow the business. The current owner works limited hours and does not advertise. You can easily add new services with little extra cost. You could expand the clothing alterations side by adding a sewing station and a seamstress. You could offer handbag, luggage, and leather repair using the current tools to earn higher profits. You could also set up a dry cleaning drop-off service to bring in more foot traffic without needing new equipment or extra rent. This is a sale of the business only. The space is leased. The sale requires the landlord to approve the lease assignment.

address: Convenience Store with Commercial Condo – Downtown
title_en: Downtown Convenience Store with Titled Commercial Condo – Pay No Rent
title_ko: 다운타운 편의점 + 상업용 콘도 소유권 (임대료 없음)
desc_ko: 캘거리 다운타운 고층 주거·오피스 빌딩에 둘러싸인 1,335 sq.ft. 상업용 콘도와 편의점 비즈니스를 함께 매매합니다. 같은 자리에서 43년, 현 소유주가 22년간 운영했습니다. 월~토 오전 9시~오후 8시 30분 영업, 일요일 휴무입니다. 관리비 월 $1,158.25 (가스, 수도, 건물 관리 포함, 전기 별도), 지하 주차 1대 포함. 앞쪽 패티오를 추가해 레스토랑이나 베이커리로 바꿀 수도 있습니다.
desc_en: Rare opportunity to own both a thriving business and the real estate in prime downtown Calgary. This turnkey convenience store occupies a 1,335 sq ft main-floor commercial condo surrounded by high-rise residential towers and office buildings. The sale includes the operating business, all equipment, fixtures, goodwill, and the titled real estate. As the owner, you will control your space and pay zero rent. The business has a strong track record, operating for 43 years in the same location and 22 years under the current owner with consistent revenue. The property offers excellent visibility, high foot traffic, and a loyal customer base from surrounding towers. Operating hours are Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:30 PM, giving you 52 Sundays off every year for great work-life balance. The monthly condo fee of $1,158.25 covers gas, water, and building management, leaving only electricity to pay separately. You will also enjoy the benefit of one assigned underground parking stall. In addition, the potential to add a front patio creates an exciting opportunity to convert the space into a restaurant or bakery. This is an ideal asset for an owner-operator or an investor seeking secure retail real estate.

title_en: Thriving Korean Food Business on 4th Street SW
title_ko: 4th Street SW 인기 한식 비즈니스 (가격 인하)
desc_ko: 캘거리에서 가장 붐비는 Mission 지역 4th Street SW의 한식 비즈니스입니다. 김밥, 떡볶이, 컵밥 등 한국 길거리 음식과 Chicko Chicken 치킨, 두 가지 콘셉트를 한 매장에서 운영합니다. 단골 고객과 꾸준한 유동 인구가 있으며, 워크인 쿨러와 냉동고를 갖춘 주방이 완비되어 있습니다. 총 2,054 sq.ft. 최근 $99,000로 가격을 인하했습니다.
desc_en: KOREA'S FLAVOUR. CALGARY'S FAVOURITE. A thriving Korean food business on 4th Street SW in Mission, one of Calgary's busiest and most walkable districts, home to two beloved concepts under one roof: authentic street food (kimbap, tteokbokki, cupbap, and noodle bowls) and Chicko Chicken Alberta's famous double-fried chicken with signature Spicy Yangnyeom and Cheese Snow sauces. Fresh ingredients. Bold, true-to-Seoul flavour. A menu built for how people eat today, quick bites, casual meals, and first-time discoveries of Korean cuisine. Loyal customers. Steady foot traffic. A fully equipped commercial kitchen, complete with prep table, walk-in cooler, and walk-in freezer, ready to go from day one. This is a rare turn-key opportunity to own a proven, well-reviewed business in one of Calgary's busiest districts, with the customer base and location already working in your favour.

title_en: Established Dry Cleaning Depot & Alterations – Owner Retiring
title_ko: 세탁소 디포 & 옷 수선 – 소유주 은퇴로 매매
desc_ko: 2005년부터 운영 중인 세탁소 디포 및 옷 수선 비즈니스로, 현 소유주가 15년 넘게 운영하다 은퇴를 위해 매매합니다. 주변에 직접 경쟁 업체가 없고 단골 고객이 많습니다. 번화한 쇼핑센터 안에 있어 유동 인구가 꾸준합니다. 1인 운영이 가능하며, 옷 수선 서비스를 늘리면 매출을 더 올릴 수 있습니다. 월 임대료 $3,142.85 (기본 임대료 $32.50/sq.ft. + 관리비, 공과금 별도), 2036년 1월까지 10년 리스 + 5년 연장 옵션.
desc_en: This established dry cleaning depot and alterations business has been operating successfully since 2005. The current owner has run the business for over 15 years and is now selling to transition into retirement. Over the years, the business has secured a highly loyal and steady customer base with the advantage of no direct competition in the immediate area. The shop is strategically situated in a busy shopping centre surrounded by high-traffic retail tenants. This prime location offers excellent visibility and generates consistent foot traffic daily. The business features simple operations that can be easily managed by a single operator. There is great potential to increase sales by expanding the alterations services, as many current customers are actively requesting it. The total monthly rent is $3,142.85, which includes a base rent of $32.50 per square foot and operating costs. Utilities are billed separately. The lease has been securely renewed for a 10-year term expiring in January 2036, and it includes an additional 5-year renewal option. This is a turnkey opportunity to acquire a stable business with low competition and simple daily management.

title_en: Retail Condo Unit at New Horizon Mall – Never Occupied
title_ko: 뉴 호라이즌 몰 상가 콘도 유닛 – 신규, 미사용
desc_ko: 크로스아이언 밀스 맞은편 뉴 호라이즌 몰의 146 sq.ft. 상가 유닛(J18)입니다. 메인 홀과 출구 가까이에 있어 고객이 찾기 쉽고, 유리 출입문으로 노출이 좋습니다. 2018년 이후 한 번도 사용하지 않은 깨끗한 공간으로 바로 입점할 수 있습니다. 월 관리비 $329.92.
desc_en: This is a great opportunity to own a commercial space at New Horizon Mall. The unit number is J18. The total space is 146 square feet. The monthly condo fee is $329.92. It is in a great location and is very easy for customers to find. The unit is close to the exit and near the main hall. There are no other units located behind this line of stores. The glass front door offers excellent visibility to attract customers. This space has never been occupied since 2018. It is a clean and empty space that is ready for your new business.

title_en: Fully Developed Boutique Unit at New Horizon Mall
title_ko: 뉴 호라이즌 몰 부티크 유닛 – 인테리어 완료
desc_ko: 크로스아이언 밀스 맞은편 뉴 호라이즌 몰의 인테리어가 완료된 부티크 유닛입니다. 몰에서 가장 합리적인 가격의 완성형 유닛으로, 임대료 대신 내 공간에 투자할 수 있는 기회입니다. 새 매장이 계속 문을 열고 있으며, 대형 실내 놀이터 Sky Castle로 가족 단위 방문객이 많습니다.
desc_en: Stop paying rent and start building equity in your own space at New Horizon Mall! Located across from Cross Iron Mills, this area attracts shoppers from all over, making it a prime spot to become your own boss. This is the best-priced, completely developed boutique unit available in the mall, making now the perfect time to invest. With new stores opening every week and the massive Sky Castle indoor playground, New Horizon Mall is a top destination for family fun and shopping.

title_en: Upgraded Former Show Suite – 2 Bed, 2 Bath Main-Floor Condo
title_ko: 업그레이드된 쇼룸 출신 콘도 – 침실 2, 욕실 2, 1층 유닛
desc_ko: 모델하우스로 사용되었던 업그레이드 콘도입니다. 두 침실이 거실 양쪽으로 나뉜 구조로 사생활이 보장됩니다. 1층 유닛으로 9피트 천장, 쿼츠 상판, 마블 타일 백스플래시, 스테인리스 가전, 42인치 상부장을 갖추고 있습니다. 안방에는 워크인 클로젯과 전용 욕실이 있고, 개인 패티오와 세탁기·건조기가 있습니다. 지하 주차 1대와 창고 포함. Sage Hill Crossing, T&T 슈퍼마켓, 월마트까지 걸어갈 수 있습니다. 관리비 월 $382.
desc_en: This previous show-suite features a functional split-bedroom design, offering maximum privacy by separating the two bedrooms with a central living area. The unit is thoughtfully finished with numerous premium upgrades. As a main-floor unit, this home features 9-foot ceilings that create a spacious and open atmosphere. The entry foyer includes a coat closet and leads into a modern open-concept space designed for both daily living and entertaining. The gourmet kitchen features Blizzard-Quartz countertops, a marble tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances. A breakfast bar that overlooks the living room and a designated dining area. The cabinetry is upgraded with 42-inch upper cabinets, under-cabinet lighting, and undermount sinks. The primary suite fits a king or queen-sized bed and includes a private walk-in closet. The attached ensuite bathroom features a deluxe shower and a quartz countertop with a banjo arm for extra surface space. On the opposite side of the unit, the second bedroom fits a queen bed and sits directly next to the second full bathroom, which includes a deep soaker tub. High-end finishes are found throughout the home, including silver oak cork flooring, custom lighting, and designer wallpaper. The living room comes with a pre-installed TV mount and provides direct access to a private concrete patio. For extra convenience, the in-suite laundry room includes a stacked washer and dryer with a built-in organizer. This home is located within walking distance of Sage Hill Crossing, T&T Supermarket, and Walmart.
